subject: Future Tech
title: Quantum Gates and Circuits
description: A quick, practical guide to Quantum Gates and Circuits.

hook.text: Classical computers use AND, OR, and NOT gates. Quantum computers use gates that rotate qubits on a sphere.

buildup.text: The Bloch sphere maps every possible qubit state to a point. Gates spin that point to a new position.

discovery.text: The Hadamard gate is the workhorse. It puts a qubit into perfect superposition, equally 0 and 1.

twist.text: Quantum gates must be reversible. Every operation can be undone, unlike classical gates that can lose bits.

climax.text: Stringing gates together builds quantum circuits. A good circuit channels superposition into correct answers.

punchline.text: Quantum gates spin possibilities into answers.

quiz.question: What does the Hadamard gate do to a qubit?
